AC amendment (gap-analysis, implicit_assumption): assert the normalize_verdict adapter-name vocabulary matches fd41's manifest verdict_adapter names — the test MUST enumerate every distinct verdict_adapter name in the consumed manifest and assert each resolves to a normalize_verdict case arm; a manifest adapter name with no matching arm MUST hit the catch-all 'UNKNOWN ADAPTER' loud non-zero path (not silent skip).
  Verify: bash tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh 2>&1 | grep -Eqv 'UNKNOWN ADAPTER'  (real run resolves every manifest adapter name) AND the unknown-adapter negative AC (#9) proves the loud path fires for an unrecognized name.
